info.title: Module
info.description: A module is a structured compartment used to store, organize, and manage specific types of data, allowing businesses to efficiently handle different entities such as tickets, contacts, products, price details, and more.

get.summary: Get Modules Accessible To Current User Profile
get.description: The API fetches a list of modules that are accessible to the current user profile.

The API fetches all the modules available in Zoho Desk.

This API is deprecated, use api/v1/organizationModules api for fetching modules.

post.description: Creates a custom module. Custom modules allow you to organize, store, and manage specific types of data tailored to unique business requirements.
